title: Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) Coverage Policy
source: Synthetic research fixture; not an authoritative payer policy
narrative: Therapeutic continuous glucose monitor (CGM) systems are covered for beneficiaries diagnosed with diabetes mellitus who are treated with insulin and require frequent glucose adjustments.

requirements.description: Established diagnosis of diabetes mellitus (Type 1 or Type 2)
requirements.rationale: CGM systems are covered only for patients with diabetes.
Medicare and commercial coverage guidelines require active insulin therapy for CGM coverage.
